title: Bounded local image linking, QA masks and ID-based collection combination

entry_inventory.interpretation: Name inventory only; not complete parameter, numerical or project migration compatibility

implementation.link: Finite unique-key matching, named-band/property overwrite, unmatched selected bands fully NoData and selected properties null; primary actual source ID, footprint and unselected metadata retained. Explicit selected system metadata follows overwrite semantics separately from actual source identity.
implementation.combine: Inner by actual system:index metadata, primary order and source identity retained; secondary collision suffix or overwrite in primary position. Empty intersection stays empty.
implementation.source_proofs: Fresh indexed actual-item lookup, exact selected pixel-DAG lineage, one observation per source, matching actual timestamps, equal raw/effective footprints, compatible CRS/affine lattices and asset projection evidence. Hidden addBands sources cannot use wrapper metadata as alignment proof.
implementation.metadata_and_budget: Detached selected metadata; string-or-list selectors; no-selection for omitted/null/[] lists is an explicit local policy. Set/dict indexes avoid repeated quadratic name scans. Indexed frame materialization precharges source/property/rebind/output work before copies. Existing compiler50000, graph500/1MB and collection1000 limits remain.
implementation.data_admission: Different-CID pair-proof component is supported, but existing catalog acceptance remains unchanged. Unaccepted dataset IDs reject; no automatic Google cloud-probability dataset admission.

full_pytest.scope: Complete existing suite on this host. Native unmix workflow is skipped without its cleaned-up temporary adapter; unchanged JVM components were not rebuilt in this compiler-only batch.

verification.independent_sample_scope: 7 raster outputs per SDK, 84 cells each (66 finite and18 NoData). Hand-authored expected arrays, primary/QA masks, both overwrite policies and cloud threshold; not a native engine execution.
negative_controls: missing match keeps primary pixels and masks only requested QA
missing requested band on actual match rejects
ambiguous duplicate keys and invalid match values reject
item/asset grid contradiction, time and footprint drift reject
hidden selected source time/footprint mismatch through nested addBands rejects
fresh compilation rechecks mutable catalog evidence
near-budget frame/time validation rejects before _base_properties copies
normal pinned SDK None defaults are omitted in wire and compile using declared defaults

review.read_only_independent_contract_review: no remaining concrete semantic or pre-allocation-budget blocker

investigated_and_fixed: all-masked unmatched band must not enter finite pure-constant binder
wrapper Image.source is insufficient to prove actual selected raster source alignment
duplicate/name lookups and frame/property copies require precharged bounded work
investigated_and_retracted: A suspected optional-None SDK bug was disproven by actual pinned serialization: None args are omitted; regression added without changing normal defaults.
limits_and_unverified: Strict local duplicate, same-time and equal-footprint rules are narrower than Google arbitrary matching behavior.
Null/empty selector equivalence is a documented local policy; no Google same-data oracle.
Raster-array bands, implicit reprojection/time broadcast and general collection metadata changes are not introduced.
No new native GeoTrellis/full Spark/HTTP/browser/physical-export/deployment/Google or private-data acceptance in this batch.
Unmix default256x256 execution still rejects under existing budget; current3x3 simplex maximum remains26 pixels. Fast-kernel design was reviewed but not implemented or claimed proven.
RGB roundtrip remains close to the shared compiler budget; this batch does not solve larger graph composability.
